subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir manifested his tentacles and prepared to fly as the Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade.
source_quote: Zalthir manifested his tentacles and prepared to fly as the Earth Elemental smashed through the ochre jelly barricade.

subject: Zalthir
fact: The Earth Elemental hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room.
source_quote: The elemental then hurled Zalthir thirty feet into the throne room.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir teleported an additional sixty feet closer to the Pudding King before walking the final forty-five feet to reach him.
source_quote: the dragonborn teleported an additional sixty feet closer to the Pudding King before walking the final forty-five feet to reach him.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir struck the gnomish villain and successfully wrapped his tentacles around him in a grapple.
source_quote: Zalthir struck the gnomish villain and successfully wrapped his tentacles around him in a grapple.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King transformed into an ooze form, his body becoming a shifting, amorphous mass.
source_quote: In response to being grappled, the Pudding King transformed into an ooze form, his body becoming a shifting, amorphous mass.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir maintained his grip and used his remaining movement to drag the Pudding King fifteen feet south, away from his ooze allies.
source_quote: Despite the transformation, Zalthir maintained his grip and used his remaining movement to drag the Pudding King fifteen feet south, away from his ooze allies.

subject: Dasco Pickshine
fact: Dasco Pickshine was unwaveringly committed to brand promotion, with every piece of his clothing and equipment bearing his company's logo.
source_quote: Every piece of Dasco Pickshine's clothing and equipment bore his company's logo, demonstrating his unwavering commitment to brand promotion.

subject: Dasco Pickshine
fact: Dasco Pickshine personally sewed a Dasco Pickshine patch onto Daz's clothes, standing proudly beside the much taller dragonborn.
source_quote: he personally sewed a Dasco Pickshine patch onto Daz's clothes, standing proudly beside the much taller dragonborn.

subject: Chipgrin
fact: Chipgrin and his wererats took offense at any suggestion they might be noisy and emphasized their stealth capabilities.
source_quote: Chipgrin and his wererats, taking offense at any suggestion they might be noisy, emphasized their stealth capabilities.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin agreed that walking across the bridge would be just as satisfying as jumping, after a dialogue with his sentient sword Dawnbringer.
source_quote: After a brief dialogue between dwarf and blade, Thorin agreed that walking would be just as satisfying.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer argued against Thorin getting stuck in acid.
source_quote: his sentient sword Dawnbringer argued against getting stuck in acid.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar made a bet that Thorin couldn't clear the gap with his pack on.
source_quote: Jimjar made a bet that Thorin couldn't clear the gap with his pack on.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar made a joke about Daz's reflection being better looking than the real thing.
source_quote: Jimjar made a joke about Daz's reflection being better looking than the real thing.

subject: Chipgrin
fact: Chipgrin went to investigate and found the second wererat scout caught and terrified, unable to move.
source_quote: After ten anxious minutes, Chipgrin went to investigate and found the scout caught and terrified, unable to move.

subject: Chipgrin
fact: Chipgrin reported that the tunnel walls had transformed into sheets of gelatinous slime acting as dark, weeping mirrors with psychic effects.
source_quote: He reported that the tunnel walls had transformed into sheets of gelatinous slime acting as dark, weeping mirrors with psychic effects.

subject: Chipgrin
fact: Chipgrin offered two options: his pack could howl at a frequency that would drown out the psychic effect, but this would draw all the oozes to attack the wererats.
source_quote: Chipgrin offered two options: his pack could howl at a frequency that would drown out the psychic effect, allowing the party to walk through safely, but this would draw all the oozes to attack the wererats, leaving the party without scouts or backup.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool promised he would never hurt his friends.
source_quote: the intelligent ooze promised he would never hurt his friends.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool recalled an earlier incident where he had heard a voice calling him from a large pool of slimes.
source_quote: however, he recalled an earlier incident where he had heard a voice calling him from a large pool of slimes.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King was gloating about the impending defeat of Blingdenstone and periodically cheered as he described members of the Blingdenstone army being consumed by oozes.
source_quote: He gloated about the impending defeat of Blingdenstone, periodically cheering as he described members of the Blingdenstone army being consumed by oozes.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King ranted that Zuggtmoy thought she could take his kingdom, but Juiblex had promised it to him.
source_quote: He also ranted that Zuggtmoy, the Queen of Rot, thought she could take his kingdom, but Juiblex had promised it to him.

subject: The party's plan for the Pudding King
fact: The party realized they hadn't established a clear plan beyond the initial snatch-and-grab for what to do with the King once captured.
source_quote: They debated what to do with the King once captured, realizing they hadn't established a clear plan beyond the initial snatch-and-grab.

subject: The Earth Elemental
fact: The Earth Elemental indicated it could smash through the ochre jelly, as it wasn't affected by acid.
source_quote: The Earth Elemental indicated it could smash through the jelly, as it wasn't affected by acid.

subject: The bat familiar
fact: The bat familiar discovered a grand vaulted corridor barred by a massive, quivering wall of translucent ochre jelly.
source_quote: The creature filled the hallway from floor to ceiling, pulsing with a rhythmic thrum that matched the Pudding King's own heartbeat.

subject: The bat familiar
fact: The bat familiar navigated successfully through the pseudopods lashing out from the ochre jelly.
source_quote: though the bat navigated through them successfully.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realized that Jimjar hadn't specified how Thorin should cross and persuaded the dwarf that he could simply walk across the bridge.
source_quote: Grygum, with a flash of insight, realized that Jimjar hadn't specified how Thorin should cross and persuaded the dwarf that he could simply walk across the bridge once it was built.

subject: Senni Diggermattock
fact: Senni Diggermattock explained her fears for the civilian areas of Blingdenstone and worried that without a proper diversion, the party's failure might go unnoticed until the town was already overrun.
source_quote: Senni Diggermattock, her face etched with concern, explained her fears for the civilian areas of Blingdenstone and worried that without a proper diversion, the party's failure might go unnoticed until the town was already overrun.

subject: Senni Diggermattock
fact: Senni Diggermattock cared deeply about the people and the community they had built.
source_quote: Senni cared deeply about the people and the community they had built.

subject: Chief Dorbo
fact: Chief Dorbo was profit-motivated and focused on protecting the mines.
source_quote: It became clear that while Chief Dorbo was profit-motivated and focused on protecting the mines.

subject: Pickshine Miners
fact: The Pickshine Miners enthusiastically set to work, completing the bridge in about twenty minutes while singing cheerful songs.
source_quote: The Pickshine Miners enthusiastically set to work, completing the bridge in about twenty minutes while singing cheerful songs.

subject: Pickshine Miners
fact: The Pickshine Miners would need to stay behind to maintain the bridge against the acid, meaning they couldn't back up the party at the Pudding King's doors.
source_quote: However, he explained that if they built the bridge, they would need to stay behind to maintain it against the acid, meaning they couldn't back up the party at the Pudding King's doors.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz accepted the offer from the Pickshine Miners to bridge the pit.
source_quote: Daz accepted the offer, and the Pickshine Miners enthusiastically set to work...

subject: Daz
fact: Daz refused to engage with Jimjar's parlor games about his reflection.
source_quote: though Daz refused to engage with such parlor games.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was formally recognized as the general in charge, with Grygum and Zalthir serving as lieutenants who could also give orders.
source_quote: Daz was formally recognized as the general in charge, with Grygum and Zalthir serving as lieutenants who could also give orders.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz sent his bat familiar ahead to scout further.
source_quote: Daz sent his bat familiar ahead to scout further...

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was proclaimed by Chief Dorbo as the one who would lead the party to triumph.
source_quote: He pointed to Daz, proclaiming that the dragonborn would lead them to triumph.
